categories.name: Look
categories.description: Weather, lighting and colour. Pick one; none is tested in the game yet.

categories.name: World life
categories.description: Interiors you walk into, shops, street food, extra props and map fixes.

categories.name: Driving
categories.description: Car camera, car fixes and tuning.

categories.name: Combat & camera
categories.description: Weapons, hit reactions and fist fights.

addons.name: VisualV (free look)
addons.description: Free weather, lighting and colour overhaul based on Los Angeles photos; no ReShade. The free stand-in for the paid NVE.

addons.name: Prime Realism V
addons.description: Physically based sky and volumetric clouds; needs ReShade. Early version.

addons.name: MaxedV
addons.description: Timecycle and weather overhaul; Enhanced alpha port.

addons.name: Open GTA Online interiors
addons.description: Switches on the game's own online interiors in story mode, mostly at their real places.

addons.name: Walk-in shops and diners
addons.description: Seamless Burger Shot, Up-n-Atom and two 24/7 interiors built into the map, like GTA VI's open shops.

addons.name: Map Updates
addons.description: Unused and restored map details by the Map Fixes author (optional seasonal props).

addons.name: Extra trees and props
addons.description: GTA V Remastered: thousands of extra trees, bushes and props. Heavy on older GPUs.

addons.name: Street food vendors
addons.description: Buy food from the street carts.

addons.name: Dynamic first-person car camera
addons.description: A first-person car camera that moves with the road and your head.

addons.name: Vehicle fixes
addons.description: Fixes model, texture and light errors on hundreds of the game's own cars (358 MB).

addons.name: Benny's Motor Works
addons.description: Benny's custom shop in story mode.

addons.name: Immersive Combat
addons.description: Weapon handling and damage closer to GTA VI's trailers; install after NextGen Euphoria.

addons.name: GTA VI camera flinch
addons.description: A camera shake when you get hit.

addons.name: ActionsV
addons.description: Smoke, drink, play guitar, binoculars and more.

addons.name: Food delivery and rideshare jobs
addons.description: Deliver food and drive passengers for money.

addons.name: Jason & Lucia heads (free)
addons.description: Two reshaped freemode heads plus Menyoo outfits; may need CodeWalker's conversion on Enhanced. Untested.

packs.name: Leonida Core
packs.description: The free, stable base: GTA VI-Inspired HUD, combat camera, Drive V, NextGen Euphoria, MP cars in traffic, Map Fixes and Bugstar Fixes. One mod per job, nothing paid.

packs.name: Leonida Plus
packs.description: Core plus the safe extras: Immersive Combat, the game's own online interiors (Enable All Interiors with LemonUI) and the Jason Duval House alpha.

packs.name: Leonida Max (RTX 50)
packs.description: Plus and Better Vehicle Deformation, for NVIDIA RTX 50-series GPUs.

packs.name: Leonida Showcase (GTA VI)
packs.description: Everything that brings the free game closest to GTA VI: Plus, GTA V Remastered, Map Updates, the walk-in Burger Shot / Up-n-Atom / 24/7 shops, street food, Benny's, ActionsV, the camera flinch, the VisualV look, the dynamic first-person car camera and side jobs. VisualV and the extras aren't tested in the game yet.

variants.name: Performance
variants.description: For GTX 1070-class cards without ray tracing (the owner's PC). Locked settings follow (F5).

variants.name: Ultra
variants.description: RT-capable cards with 12 GB+ of video memory. Locked settings follow (F5).
